remarks: Come home to the Clocktower Close, a highly sought-after condo complex offering a prime location with easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North, Merritt 7, and vibrant SoNo. This 825 sq ft loft unit, with its chic Manhattan-inspired atmosphere, features stunning exposed brick walls, wood beams, soaring 20-foot ceilings, and dramatic two-story windows that flood the space with natural light. The owner has thoughtfully updated the space with hardwood floors on both levels, a refreshed kitchen complete with quartz countertops, marble backsplash, and a new dishwasher. The half bath has been upgraded with a new quartz counter, sink, and modern hardware. The open floor plan is accentuated by interior balconies that enhance the loft's distinctive NYC vibe. Natural light pours in through the expansive two-story windows, creating a bright, welcoming atmosphere throughout.  Permitted off-street parking,on-level laundry,renovated fitness center with locker rooms and sauna,dedicated dog walking area,outdoor picnic spaces, community kitchen and business flex spaces,game room, secured parking garage available. In addition to a great community complex, you'll enjoy resident-only beaches, waterfront parks, and a wealth of dining, shopping, and entertainment at your fingertips. Whether it's a morning commute, a weekend stroll through SoNo, or a sunset by the water, this loft places it all within easy reach. Great opportunity - must see!
